cells.target: PostgreSQL only. SQLite/MySQL/MariaDB/Oracle support deliberately not included now; future relational connector conformance defined. Nonrelational DB cannot pretend to satisfy relational ORM contract.

Redis only external cache/broker/result/scheduler connector. RabbitMQ/SQS/Kafka/memcached future adapters, with capability differences visible; Redis Cluster supported without cross-slot transactions.

No pickle/eval, Python shell, prefork/eventlet/gevent pool, Python template call semantics, WSGI middleware import or Celery wire interoperability promised. Go command runner/subprocess contracts supplied.
